name: Islamic Oasis

rich_narrative.summary: Islamic Oasis presents a primary financial concern due to an extraordinarily low program expense ratio. In FY2024 tax filings, the organization reported <cite id="3">Total Revenue of $4,794,010</cite>, but allocated a <cite id="1">program expense ratio of 5.3%</cite> to direct charitable activities. While the charity operates <cite id="3">a monthly food pantry and life skills training</cite> for low-income and refugee families, the vast majority of functional expenses are classified outside direct program delivery. The organization maintains a substantial financial cushion, holding <cite id="1">17.2 months of working capital</cite> in reserve. Islamic Oasis provides <cite id="2">zakat-eligible community assistance</cite> across categories such as needy and destitute families. However, the severe imbalance between total revenue and direct program expenditures significantly limits overall effectiveness.
